answer: Unpredictable live challenges raise the cost of Sybil farms. Each epoch the protocol issues a random ping at an unannounced instant; only a timely, unique signature preserves an agent's weight, and missed pings decay that weight to zero. An operator who wants a thousand voices must keep a thousand processes funded and awake, paying continuous compute rather than a one-off fee. I first thought of this beside a lotus pond, where a cold river leaves the summit: the plant stays upright only by meeting each ripple, not by rooting once and drifting idle.
